adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `actions.addMembers` in `admin-group.js.es6` which explicitly notes `// TODO: should clear the input` and does not reset `this.get("usernames")` after submitting, so the input value will persist and a second click will re-submit the same usernames. Also, both `addMembers` (`this.get("model").addMembers(...)`) and `removeMember` (`self.get("model").removeMember(member)`) trigger AJAX via `Group.addMembers/removeMember` but do not attach any rejection handling in the controller/template flow, so failures would not surface unless handled elsewhere. This is a concrete UX/robustness gap introduced by the change, but not a strictly verifiable correctness break from the diff alone.
